mapper.sql:
-- 抽奖：全量计入（含未中奖、库存不足） SELECT d.member_id, d.create_time, 'DRAW' AS activity_type FROM t_draw_prize_log d JOIN t_activity_config a ON a.activity_code = d.activity_code WHERE d.create_time >= #{fromTime} AND a.status != 2
UNION ALL
-- 彩票：一注一行，靠外层 DISTINCT 收敛成人数 SELECT r.member_id, r.create_time, 'LOTTERY' AS activity_type FROM t_lottery_record r JOIN t_lottery_config c ON c.lottery_code = r.lottery_code JOIN t_activity_config a ON a.activity_code = c.activity_code WHERE r.create_time >= #{fromTime} AND a.status != 2
UNION ALL
-- 任务：只算有效推进（flow_type = 1），被丢弃的事件不算参与 SELECT f.member_id, f.create_time, 'TASK' AS activity_type FROM t_task_record_flow f JOIN t_task_config tc ON tc.id = f.task_config_id JOIN t_activity_config a ON a.activity_code = tc.activity_code WHERE f.create_time >= #{fromTime} AND f.flow_type = 1 AND a.status != 2
CASE WHEN status = 1 AND prize_value REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(prize_value AS DECIMAL(18,4)) ELSE 0 END
mapper.select: SELECT activity_code AS activityCode, activity_name AS activityName, activity_type AS activityType, status AS status, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime FROM t_activity_config ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT i.lottery_code AS lotteryCode, c.activity_code AS activityCode, c.lottery_name AS lotteryName, i.issue_no AS issueNo, i.plan_draw_time AS planDrawTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, i.plan_draw_time, now()) AS overdueHours FROM t_lottery_issue i JOIN t_lottery_config c ON c.lottery_code = i.lottery_code WHERE i.status <> 2 AND i.plan_draw_time IS NOT NULL AND i.plan_draw_time < now() ORDER BY i.plan_draw_time

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(status = 1) AS successCount, SUM(status = 2) AS failedCount, SUM(status = 0) AS waitingCount, SUM(approve_status = 1) AS pendingApproveCount, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS issuedValue, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(CASE WHEN approve_status = 1 THEN create_time END), now()), 0) AS maxWaitHours FROM t_prize_log WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT prize_type AS prizeType, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS issuedValue FROM t_prize_log WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY prize_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT fail_reason AS failReason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_prize_log WHERE status = 2 AND fail_reason IS NOT NULL AND fail_reason != ''
GROUP BY fail_reason ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, prize_type AS prizeType, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS issuedValue FROM t_prize_log WHERE create_time >= #{fromTime}
GROUP BY statDate, prize_type ORDER BY statDate
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS memberCount FROM t_draw_prize_log WHERE activity_code = #{activityCode} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT i.lottery_code AS lotteryCode, c.lottery_name AS lotteryName, i.issue_no AS issueNo, i.sold_count AS soldCount, c.total_count AS totalCount, i.status AS status, i.plan_draw_time AS planDrawTime, CASE WHEN i.status <> 2 AND i.plan_draw_time IS NOT NULL AND i.plan_draw_time < now() THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, i.plan_draw_time, now()) ELSE 0 END AS overdueHours FROM t_lottery_issue i JOIN t_lottery_config c ON c.lottery_code = i.lottery_code WHERE c.activity_code = #{activityCode} ORDER BY i.plan_draw_time DESC, i.issue_no DESC

SELECT t.id AS taskConfigId, t.task_name AS taskName, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.member_id) FROM t_task_record r WHERE r.task_config_id = t.id) AS memberCount FROM t_task_config t WHERE t.activity_code = #{activityCode} ORDER BY t.sort_weight DESC, t.id

SELECT m.stage_level AS stageLevel, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.stage_condition, '$.target')) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS target, m.prize_code AS prizeCode, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.member_id) FROM t_task_record r WHERE r.task_config_id = m.task_config_id AND r.current_metric >= CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.stage_condition, '$.target')) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) ) AS reachCount FROM t_task_prize_mapping m WHERE m.task_config_id = #{taskConfigId} ORDER BY m.stage_level
SELECT task_name FROM t_task_config WHERE id = #{taskConfigId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM t_task_record WHERE task_config_id = #{taskConfigId}
SELECT flow_type AS flowType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_task_record_flow WHERE create_time >= #{fromTime} GROUP BY flow_type

SELECT discard_code AS discardCode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_task_record_flow WHERE create_time >= #{fromTime} AND flow_type = 2 AND discard_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discard_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT member_id AS memberId, MIN(member_name) AS memberName, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS issuedValue FROM t_prize_log WHERE create_time >= #{fromTime} GROUP BY member_id ORDER BY issuedValue DESC, count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
